visual_elements.description: Scatter plot in left top panel: vertical axis labeled x2, horizontal axis labeled x1 (no numeric ticks). Cluster of red filled circles on the left side, cluster of blue filled squares on the right side. A straight diagonal solid line labeled 'Linear boundary' separates the two clusters cleanly.

Two scatter plots in right top panel under 'Not linearly separable'. Left plot: axes x2 (vertical) and x1 (horizontal); red circles and blue squares intermixed such that a straight solid line cannot separate them; a dashed curved line labeled 'Nonlinear boundary' arcs around a group of red points; a dashed ellipse encircles a central mixed cluster. Right plot: axes x2 and x1; red circles clustered in the middle surrounded by blue squares at the corners/edges; a dashed circle drawn around the central red cluster; a solid straight line fails to separate the classes.

Large square scatter plot at bottom: both axes numeric with ticks approximately from -2.5 to 2.5 (visible tick labels include -2.5, -2, -1.5, -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5 [?]). Many small dots in three colors (red, green, blue) scattered across the plane, with a loose curved/swirled structure; a small gray tooltip-style label reading 'Data fitting [?]' near the center around (0.5, 0).
